value.rationale: The Shrikhande and 4x4 rook graphs are a canonical pair of cospectral nonisomorphic strongly regular graphs. Their graph states are qubit-LC equivalent yet universally odd-prime LU inequivalent, with a concrete four-site spectral obstruction. This resolves a natural characteristic-dependence question with an exact, reproducible census and shows why transfer of qubit graph-state equivalences to other prime dimensions fails.
